name: Inbox Zero Week — 7 Days
description: Seven days from a scary inbox to a system you can keep: fast timed sweeps with the two-minute rule, filters that kill the noise, the emails you've been avoiding finally handled, and a 10-minute daily habit so it never piles up again. For the brain that opens email, freezes, and closes the tab.

0.title: Unsubscribe from 10 senders you never actually read

1.title: One 30-min sweep — oldest first, two-minute rule: do, delete, or defer

2.title: Set up 3 filters/rules to auto-sort the noise

3.title: Handle the 3 emails you've been avoiding

4.title: Reply to everything under 2 minutes in one sweep

5.title: Get the inbox under 10 — sweep it to zero if you can

6.title: Clear the 3 non-email tasks hiding in there — a form, a call, a bill

7.title: Set a daily 10-min inbox appointment and make it a repeat
Note the system so you can re-run it in a month
